Visual Summarization Skill v1.0.0 – First stable release

- Introduces an AI-powered skill for generating coherent scene descriptions from video clips or image content.
- Enforces strict rules: prohibits use of local memory files and mandates all history queries from a cloud API with open-id authentication.
- Requires users to provide a valid open-id via config file or user input before analysis.
- Automatically extracts and summarizes scene elements such as objects, behaviors, and environments into fluent Chinese text.
- Adds support for listing and viewing reports in a Markdown table linked to cloud report images.
- Provides clear guidance and requirements for input quality and workflow usage.
